slides.texte_overlay:
daily habits that make your
confidence unshakeable

speak up early

say something in the first five minutes of every class or meeting. the longer you wait, the harder it gets, so speaking up first takes all the pressure off you.

walk without headphones

once a day, walk through a busy place with no headphones. simply being present without hiding behind music quietly trains a calm, steady kind of confidence.

send the message

stop rewriting that message for an hour and just send it. confident people aren't fearless, they simply don't let overthinking make decisions for them.

learn something daily

spend 5 minutes a day on something new: a myth, a planet, a painting. knowing you're always growing gives you a steady confidence that people can feel.

slides.texte_overlay:
dress for yourself

wear your favourite outfit on an ordinary day. choosing clothes just for yourself is a small, daily way of saying other people's opinions don't run your life.
